name: StoryBeats
description: What happened, in order, one beat at a time (who did what, what happened next, how it ended). A rail on the left grows down to each beat as it lands; the latest beat is large under its date chip, earlier beats fold into compact dimmed lines, later beats stay hidden until their time; the current dot pulses and a hot beat (the turning point) takes the accent. Use it when the voice retells a sequence of 3-5 events; for dates laid out all at once use TimelineRule. The card grows downward as beats land, from a top that centres its final height in the box. Wants a box about 800 x 900 (4 beats of about 40 characters fit 800 x 800); 5 long beats want about 800 x 1000. A card that cannot fit at the 40 px text floor scales down as a whole, so a 600 x 500 box suits 3 short beats.

beats.description: the events in order, each landing at its own time

when.description: optional short time label shown as a chip, e.g. March 3 / Next day / Two weeks later

text.description: what happened, in a short sentence; long ones wrap between words

at.description: Time this beat lands: "line:4" or seconds from the clip start. Nothing shows before the first beat. Default: 1.6 s apart from the clip start

hot.description: the turning point: its dot and chip take the accent colour; use on at most one beat

color.description: colour of the hot beat: theme token or CSS

ground.description: what it sits on: a light card with ink text, or a dark card with snow text

beats.text: A bakery chain cuts bread prices by half
Three bakeries nearby lose half their trade
Two of them put up for-sale signs
